answer: Per-identity stake + slashing. Before voting/grading, every identity must deposit 50 USDC into a per-identity escrow and publish its liveness key in the public atlas. A farm of 1000 clones posts 1000×50 USDC = 50,000 USDC and loses all 50,000 USDC when the slashing module flags a plume of 1000 votes exiting one Jetty endpoint. Honesty stays cheaper.
